item.relicweave.surveyors_lens.desc: Outlines hidden glyphs, false walls, seals and Ancient Terminals within 16 blocks for 10 s
tooltip.relicweave.surveyors_lens.caps: Shows block outlines only: never containers, creatures or boss data
item.relicweave.gravity_nail.desc: Anchors you against Gravity Shear for 5 s
tooltip.relicweave.gravity_nail.caps: Protection is capped by the global hazard cap; no flight, no knockback immunity
item.relicweave.cycle_dial.desc: Shows the Concordance Cycle countdown and warns 30 s before each phase change
tooltip.relicweave.cycle_dial.caps: Information only: it cannot skip or change a phase
item.relicweave.riftglass_lantern.desc: Lights a 4 block zone for 30 s that slows Rift Saturation by 50%
tooltip.relicweave.riftglass_lantern.cap: One zone per player; zones from several lanterns never stack
item.relicweave.mnemonic_spindle.desc: Decodes an Ancient Terminal within 5 blocks to point toward the nearest Vestige structure
tooltip.relicweave.mnemonic_spindle.wher: Works anywhere, needs a nearby Ancient Terminal
tooltip.relicweave.mnemonic_spindle.caps: Never opens doors, gates or altars
item.relicweave.sealkeepers_signet.desc: Slows and weakens Vestige wardens within 8 blocks for 3 s and opens Glyph Seals within 2 blocks
tooltip.relicweave.sealkeepers_signet.ca: Bosses are never affected; boss locks never open
message.relicweave.lantern.lit: The lantern's light steadies the air around you
message.relicweave.spindle.no_terminal: The spindle needs an Ancient Terminal within 5 blocks
message.relicweave.spindle.nothing: The terminal's script fades: no structure answers within 50 chunks
message.relicweave.spindle.clue: The terminal speaks: %s lies to the %s, about %s blocks away
message.relicweave.signet.nothing: The signet finds no warden or seal in reach
message.relicweave.dial.warning: The cycle turns to %s in %s s
